brief:
# Build: terminal-vps-host (Current profile) - URGENT ops fix

Brett, Nov 3 2026: the console Terminal shows NO headless tabs. `console-terminal/headless` read returns `{ready:false, items:[], why:"the VPS tab isn't set up (Settings -> Plugins -> Terminal -> VPS host)"}`. So headless-tabs (PR #259, live) can't attach to any build's tmux session. Assigned agent: whoever is free (all-rounder router if on main; else book on **Ping Paulie**; record who). Register in the `current` profile (id `terminal-vps-host`) + banner entry. Fix right away, tell after.

## Do
- s1 Find how the Terminal plugin (apps/console-web/plugins/console-terminal or terminal) stores the VPS host connection and what it needs (host, user, port, SSH key/agent). Configure it for the axf-console container to reach the VPS host (same Hostinger VPS: host.docker.internal / docker gateway / the VPS address) as root with a dedicated key: generate an ed25519 key for the console, add its public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys (restricted is fine), store the private key in the console's secure store / a mounted secret (never in the repo, never echoed in logs).
- s2 Make the setting persistent across container redeploys (Coolify env/secret or mounted volume) so Lenny's landings don't wipe it. If Coolify config is needed, document it and use the existing Coolify API path (COOLIFY_TOKEN) if available.
- s3 Verify: `console-terminal/headless` returns ready:true and lists the running axf-* tmux sessions (toolbar-tap-confirm, crew-live, auto-land-2, ui-review-shots, follow-amber, claude-settings, ...); meters return cost; opening the Terminal auto-opens a tab per build with agent + model + live cost.
- s4 Add a health@1 check: red when the Terminal VPS host isn't ready, with Auto fix. Systems check banner row.
- s5 Report `_claude/builds/reports/terminal-vps-host.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.

steps.text: Configure the Terminal VPS host: console ed25519 key, authorized on the host, host = coolify gateway
Persist the setting across redeploys (bind-mounted dataDir) and auto-detect the host
Verify headless list, meters and auto-opened tabs
health@1 check: Terminal VPS host ready, with Auto fix

tests.name: From the console: headless → ready:true, 6 sessions (auto-land-2, ui-review-shots, follow-amber, claude-settings, agent-pick, terminal-vps-host), each with agent + model.
headless/meters → ready:true with costUsd, tokens, status per session.
Tests: terminal self-test 106/106 (was 97 + the flake failing on this host).
The browser side (auto-open a tab per build) is PR #259's web/headless.ts, unchanged; it only needed ready:true.

open: The health item appears once this PR is on main and the console restarts (plugins load from `/opt/axf`).
